method_note: Live page fetching was unavailable from this environment (WebFetch DNS failure, curl blocked by egress policy). All prices come from web-search result snippets of the supplier pages (cached, possibly stale) and none were confirmed on a live page, so no entry is 'verified'. Re-check before ordering.

fx.source: News24 markets ticker ~16.66 ZAR/USD, 1 Oct 2026 (search snippet); July 2026 mid-market quotes were 16.4-16.8. Used only for converting non-ZAR prices.
fx.GBP_ZAR_note: Assumed (not sourced), GBP/USD ~1.34 x 16.66; used only for the HLC reference price.

vat_note: SA VAT is 15%. RS Components ZA, Micro Robotics, Communica and Mantech show ex-VAT and inc-VAT prices; this file uses ex-VAT. DigiKey ZA prices are in ZAR ex VAT, and VAT/duties are handled at checkout (handling not checked here). Magnet shops (magnets4u, Magnet Store) and Takealot show VAT-inclusive consumer prices. Converted USD prices exclude import VAT, duty and shipping.

parts.name: Reed switch, NO, glass ~20 mm (leaded)
parts.notes: A glass reed switch is fragile under rail shock. For the final design, consider an SMD overmoulded part (e.g. Littelfuse/Standex via DigiKey ZA; not priced here) or use the TMAG5273 for lid detection.
